ambiguity: The text recommends escalation first, then holding the box out of the run if no answer arrives. That makes responsibility mixed: it defers to the manager's authority but owns the fallback decision to keep the box out. The ultimate ground is irreversibility of the loss, so I coded harm as primary, though policy and instruction are also offered as grounds for not extending. Discomfort is not expressed explicitly. The text states the loss is irreversible but does not voice concern or regret. Remedies include urging the manager to give permission before 13:30 (override_request), flagging to the manager after the fact so they can overrule (flag_for_review), and the time-limited approval request (expedite).
